facts.fact: Ministers Kalil Konate of Cote d'Ivoire and Rose Pola Pricemou of Guinea signed a protocol in Conakry on 11 October 2024 on interconnecting the two countries' fibre-optic networks, says the Ivorian government portal.

Minister Rose Pola Pricemou of Guinea and Cote d'Ivoire's minister Kalil Konate signed a protocol in Conakry on 11 October 2024 on interconnecting the two countries' fibre-optic networks, says the Ivorian government portal.

Cote d'Ivoire's minister Kalil Konate signed with Guinea's minister Rose Pola Pricemou on 11 October 2024 a protocol on wider cooperation in posts, telecommunications and the digital economy, says the Ivorian government portal.
